content.title: Test patchnotes
items: This is sample content for testing the patchnotes viewer. It does not describe an actual SoManyStyles release.
Use this entry to check headings, dates, text wrapping and the content scrollbar at different GUI scales.

content.title: Added
items: Example: A Guide screen with a scrollable list of sections and a plain text reading area.
Example: Guide and Patchnotes buttons at the top of the screen, with a visible highlight for the selected mode.
Example: A version list that lets you read notes from several releases without leaving the screen.

content.title: Improved
items: Example: Longer descriptions wrap to fit the content panel. Resize the window or change GUI scale to check that the text remains readable and stays inside its panel.
Example: The section list and the content panel scroll independently. Move the pointer between them to check which panel receives wheel input.
Example: The selected version and reading position are remembered when switching between Guide and Patchnotes.

content.title: Things to try
items: Scroll all the way to the bottom, then drag the scrollbar thumb back to the top.
Select the older test version on the left and check that its date and content appear on the right.
Close and reopen the screen. The loaded feed should remain available from memory for the rest of this Minecraft session.
After changing the feed on GitHub, restart Minecraft before checking the new content. The viewer intentionally keeps the first result for the entire session.

content.title: End of test entry
items: If you can read this final paragraph, the bottom of the article is reachable. Remove these test entries before publishing real release notes.

content.title: Older test entry
items: This second sample exists to test version selection and newest-date-first ordering. It is not an actual release.
Its content is deliberately short so you can compare the scrollbar with the longer test entry.
